# Track Studio 1.2.7

This release adds SET sharing and cloud sync, improves Mixtape automation editing and export, and introduces one-click BPM drift repair.

## New Features

- **SET import and export:** Share SET packages with audio, track information, beat grids, Cue points, and available waveforms. Import them into another library and view the total duration of selected SET tracks.
- **SET cloud sync:** Sync folders, playlists, track order, audio, and analysis data across computers. Review conflicting changes and choose which side to keep.
- **Mixtape envelope editing:** Drag points horizontally or vertically, adjust line segments, draw ramps, edit a selected range, and bend transitions. Includes magnetic grid snapping, Shift fine adjustment, Alt to bypass snapping, exact dB entry, undo/redo, and an expanded editing area.
- **Mixtape controls:** Adjust gain across the project, view Cue markers, and align tracks using Hot Cues.
- **One-click BPM drift repair:** Automatically analyze and repair selected tracks without setting the BPM for each track individually.
- **Library navigation:** Locate library folders and playlists in the system file browser from their context menu. USB playlists also support split-view search and independent list settings.
- **rekordbox integration:** Add rekordbox tracks to SET with managed audio copies, and write supported changes while rekordbox is running, with a warning before proceeding.

## Bug Fixes

- Improved Mixtape playback timing, beat-grid alignment, start synchronization, tempo-curve playback, and playhead following. Fixed overview playhead positioning and loop-grid selection at low zoom levels.
- Improved Mixtape export speed through parallel tempo processing, with progress based on measured processing rates and clearer elapsed-time and remaining-time displays.
- Fixed missing waveforms and tracks being incorrectly removed when reopening Mixtape projects created from SET playlists. Corrected mute-overlay boundaries and kept volume mute blocks visible.
- Improved SET import cleanup, managed-audio retention, waveform transfer, and opening speed. Fixed unreferenced managed tracks not entering the recycle bin after playlist deletion.
- Fixed SET sync freezes and settings becoming unresponsive during synchronization. Improved track metadata caching and analysis-component updates.
- Improved dual-deck synchronization and linked beat-grid editing, fixed stale beat highlighting when switching preview tracks, and refined small-window dialogs and English interface text.

# Track Studio 1.2.7 中文更新说明

本次更新新增 SET 分享与云同步，完善 Mixtape 自动录制的包络编辑和导出，并加入 BPM 漂移一键自动修复。

## 新功能

- **SET 导入导出：**将音频、曲目信息、节拍网格、Cue 点和已有波形一起打包分享，并导入其他资料库；支持统计选中 SET 曲目的总时长。
- **SET 库云同步：**跨电脑同步文件夹、歌单、曲目顺序、音频和分析数据；遇到两边同时修改的内容时，可查看冲突并选择保留哪一边。
- **Mixtape 包络编辑：**支持节点横向与纵向拖动、线段调整、画直线、范围调整和弯曲过渡；提供磁性网格吸附、Shift 微调、Alt 暂停吸附、精确 dB 输入、撤销重做及展开编辑区。
- **Mixtape 操作：**支持工程级增益调整、Cue 标记显示，以及按 Hot Cue 对齐曲目。
- **BPM 漂移一键修复：**自动分析并修复选中的歌曲，无需逐首设置 BPM。
- **资料库定位：**通过右键菜单在系统文件管理器中定位库文件夹或歌单；U 盘歌单支持分栏搜索与独立列表配置。
- **rekordbox 集成：**支持将 rekordbox 歌曲以托管音频副本加入 SET，并支持在 rekordbox 运行时写入受支持的改动，操作前提供风险提示。

## 问题修复

- 改善 Mixtape 播放时钟、拍线对齐、起播同步、变速曲线播放和播放线跟随；修复概览播放线定位与低缩放时循环网格选择。
- 通过并行变速处理提升 Mixtape 导出速度，进度按实测速率分配，并完善已用时间和预计剩余时间显示。
- 修复从 SET 歌单创建的录制工程重新打开后波形空白、曲目被误移除的问题；修正静音蒙层边界，并始终显示音量静音块。
- 完善 SET 导入后的源文件夹清理、托管音频保留、波形传输与打开速度；修复删除歌单后无引用的托管曲目未进入回收站。
- 修复 SET 同步卡死、同步期间设置保存无响应，改善歌曲元数据缓存和分析组件按需更新。
- 改善双轨同步与联结网格编辑，修复预听切歌后残留上一首刻度高亮，完善小窗口弹窗与英文界面文案。
